name: Fukuoka
days: ~half day (transit stop en route from Beppu/Yufuin to Tokyo, together with friend)
overview: Food-focused stop, since it's short. Willing to flex vegetarian for the real Hakata ramen experience rather than hunting for a veg-only version.

recommendations.title: Hakata ramen
recommendations.summary: Signature tonkotsu (pork bone) broth — willing to flex vegetarian for this.
recommendations.body: Rich, milky tonkotsu (pork bone) broth, thin firm noodles. Well-regarded spots: Ichiran (famous individual-booth chain, originated here) and Shin Shin. Most counters open 11am-midnight, some 24-hour spots near Nakasu. If ever wanting a vegetarian version without flexing, BUGORO All Vegan makes a vegan Hakata-style ramen.

recommendations.title: Yatai (open-air stalls)
recommendations.summary: Nakasu/Tenjin districts — tiny stalls along the river, for the atmosphere.
recommendations.body: Nakasu and Tenjin are the main yatai districts — tiny stalls along the river serving ramen, yakitori, oden, and more. Don't operate in heavy rain — check the evening forecast if planning a specific night around this.

recommendations.title: Mentaiko
recommendations.summary: Beloved local specialty, good food souvenir.
recommendations.body: Spicy marinated cod roe, a beloved Fukuoka specialty. Often not vegetarian-compatible as a dish itself, but a good food-culture souvenir (vacuum-packed, keeps 2-3 weeks refrigerated).

recommendations.title: Ohori Park
recommendations.summary: Large park built around a lake, former outer moat of Fukuoka Castle.
recommendations.body: Walking paths circling the water — genuine green space in the city, easy half-day fit.

recommendations.title: Uminonakamichi Seaside Park
recommendations.summary: Coastal park further out, beaches and flower fields.
recommendations.body: More expansive than Ohori if there's time for it — beaches, flower fields, open space.

openQuestions: Given this is a short transit stop, may need to pick just one or two recommendations rather than fitting everything — revisit once exact timing is locked
